description:
Mirror of the NOAA National Hurricane Center GIS forecast products for Hurricane Melissa (AL132025, 21-31 October 2025): forecast cone, track, points and coastal watches/warnings for all 80 advisories, the initial and forecast wind radii, the 120-hour wind speed probabilities for the 34 forecast cycles (clipped to the Caribbean), and the working best track (points, line, wind radii, wind swath). NHC attribute names and values are kept verbatim; derived columns (advisory_number, advisory_seq, issue_time, synoptic_time, valid_time, radii_kind, cycle_time, wind_threshold_kt, pct_min, pct_max) are documented per Collection. Shapefiles downloaded from the NHC GIS archive on 2026-09-23 and converted to GeoParquet by CARTO for a UNICEF children-in-emergencies demo. US Government work, public domain (NOAA/NWS disclaimer).

**Disclaimer:** a demonstration of Portolan as cloud-native infrastructure for disseminating open geodatasets. This catalog republishes data from its original publishers in cloud-native formats such as GeoParquet and PMTiles, with STAC metadata — open, standards-based and freely accessible to everyone. It is not an official service of the original publishers, which remain the authoritative source.
